messages:
Maya (Sales): FYI — new POC with AegisHealth. Requirements: SSO (SAML), SCIM bulk ingest (~50k users) + daily deltas, RBAC group sync and domain verification. Two potential blockers: contractors routed via a SAML proxy that rewrites NameID, and they want full-replace semantics during a short sync window (~400 rps). Pricing question: Hosted vs Dedicated for sustained SCIM load. @Rach @Lina please advise.

Rach (SE): Quick clarification — does the proxy keep the same IdP issuer or present as a different issuer? Same issuer = claim transform possible; different issuer = alias mapping required.

Ana (Prospect): Same Azure AD issuer but contractors proxy rewrites NameID to a contractor token. We can provide a sample CSV and metadata. Peak window ~8-12 minutes, so expect bursts up to ~400 rps.

Ethan (Eng): We support an alias map keyed by (idp_issuer, nameid) -> internal_id. For heavy imports we recommend staged ingest via bulk-import which applies idempotent upserts. Example ingest: 
```
curl -X POST https://redwood/api/v1/bulk-import \\ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \\ 
  -F file=@users.csv
```
Also: enable name_id_aliases=true, scim_chunk_size=500, and alias_write_cooldown during initial import to avoid db churn.

Lina (Security): Security notes: SCIM bearer token rotation (hourly) must be validated with their proxy. Hosted supports AES-256 at rest + cloud KMS; if they require BYO-KMS/HSM or segregated audit streams recommend Private. For throughput + cost predictability Dedicated is usually the right call. I'll draft the security questionnaire answers for KMS, token rotation, RBAC audit trails and log retention.

ticket-bot: created POC-10077 "AegisHealth SCIM ingest + NameID aliasing" assigned to eng-platform.

Maya (Sales): Thanks — scheduling a 30m technical sync Tue 10am PT (Ana, Rach, Lina, Ethan). Ana please upload CSV + Azure metadata ahead of the call. Rach — can you post a ballpark Dedicated commit for a 3-month POC so we can prep the quote?

Rach (SE): Ballpark: short-term Dedicated reserved pool (S-class) with burst; expect mid five-figure USD/month depending on audit retention and SLA. Will confirm exact tiers with pricing-ops and post link here.
